data.name: GuideIntro
data.value: {App} reads PDFs and puts them in order. Every change happens on screen first and can be undone; the file only changes when you save. The functions are in the ribbon, many also in the right-click menu of a page; the tooltips show the keyboard shortcuts.

data.name: GuideOpenText
data.value: Click Open… ({0}+O), pick a file from Recent or drop a PDF onto the window. Every document gets its own window; {0}+N opens an empty one. In the file manager, the right-click menu offers “Read with {App}” and, for several PDFs, “Merge with {App}”.

data.name: GuideReadText
data.value: The pages sit side by side: scroll with the mouse wheel, the arrow keys, Page Up/Down or by dragging with the mouse. Zoom with {0}+mouse wheel, the zoom field or the buttons in the status bar; the View tab fits the pages to height, width or both. Click the page number in the status bar ({0}+G) to jump to a page; {0}+T shows thumbnails on the left.

data.name: GuideOrganizeText
data.value: {0}+2 (or Organize) shows all pages as thumbnails, {0}+1 goes back to reading. Click to select, {0}+click for more, Shift+click for a range, {0}+A for all. Drag the selected pages to a new place to reorder them. A double-click opens a page for reading.

data.name: GuidePagesText
data.value: Rotate left or right ({0}+L / {0}+R) or several pages at once with Rotate… ({0}+Shift+R); delete with Del. Insert before / Insert after adds pages of another PDF at the current page (you choose which), Blank page before / after adds an empty page. Replace swaps consecutive pages for pages of another open document or PDF file. Right-click a page for the same actions.

data.name: GuideStampText
data.value: Insert stamp puts a picture from your stamp folder on the page – a signature, company stamp or logo (PNG, transparency is kept). Click the page to place it, then drag to move, pull a corner to resize; Del removes it. The stamp folder is set in Settings; pictures in a subfolder get a section of their own, e.g. the numbers 0–20 for marking an order. A stamp can show the date: “Received” writes today's date when it is placed, a double click on it changes the date until you save. Use New stamp… in the gallery to make your own from a PNG picture, or right-click a stamp to edit it.

data.name: GuideTextText
data.value: Choose Insert text, click the page and type; Esc or a click elsewhere finishes. Pen colour sets colour, font and size. Templates places saved text snippets in which the date, page number or file name are filled in; each is a text file in the templates folder (set in Settings). The text is saved as real PDF text: searchable and selectable.

data.name: GuideOcrText
data.value: Recognize text… makes scanned pages searchable: the recognized words are saved as an invisible text layer, the page looks the same. "Select text" shows what text a page has: drag over it to highlight the text, {0}+C copies it. In Organize mode, {0}+C copies the text of the selected pages.

data.name: GuideConcatenateText
data.value: Merge… builds a new document from several PDFs: add files (or drop them onto the dialog), Open documents adds those of your other windows, then put them in order. The open document can be part of it, including its unsaved changes.

data.name: GuideExtractText
data.value: Extract pages… saves the selected pages as a new PDF. Split… cuts the document into several files, every N pages or at the selected pages. The open document stays as it is.

data.name: GuideReduceText
data.value: Reduce Size… scales scans and pictures down to 200, 150 or 100 dpi and saves the smaller copy under a new name. Text and drawings stay exactly as they are; a message tells how much smaller the file got.

data.name: GuidePrintText
data.value: Print… ({0}+P) prints all pages, the current page or a range – with all your changes. “Properties…” opens the printer’s own settings (tray, two-sided, paper …).

data.name: GuideMailText
data.value: “Email” opens a new message in your email program with the document attached – as you see it, with all changes, even unsaved ones. The email program is the one set as default in your system.

data.name: GuideAttachmentsText
data.value: {App} recognizes electronic invoices in the formats ZUGFeRD, Factur-X and XRechnung: if a PDF contains the invoice data as XML, a bar above the pages says so. “Open XML” shows it in the program your system uses for XML files, “Save XML…” stores it, e.g. for your accounting software. Attachments… (Home tab, also in the File menu; only shown when the PDF has embedded files) lists every file in the PDF to open or save; files that could contain a program are only saved, not opened. Saving keeps the attachments and the invoice data.

data.name: GuideSaveText
data.value: Every step can be undone and redone ({0}+Z / {0}+Y). A dot in the window title shows unsaved changes. Save ({0}+S) replaces the file safely and keeps bookmarks and form fields; Save As ({0}+Shift+S) writes a new file. Before closing, you are asked about unsaved changes.

data.name: GuideSettingsText
data.value: Settings… ({0}+,) switches between light and dark and between English and German; on Windows and Linux the menu bar can also be switched on there. {0}+F1 or the arrow at the right end of the tabs folds the ribbon away for more room; a click on a tab brings it back. The gear at the top right opens the settings from any tab, F1 or the ? next to it opens this guide, the i button shows the version.

data.name: GuideRedactText
data.value: Black out hides confidential passages behind a black box, White out covers content in white as if the paper were empty. With either tool, drag over text to cover exactly those words, or draw a box around any area – pictures and scans too; with Select text, a click on the button covers the selected text. Drag a box to move it, pull a corner to resize it, Del removes it. When saving, everything under the boxes is removed from the file for good: text, pictures, drawings, comments and form entries; the rest of the page stays as it is. Before the original file is overwritten, a warning offers to save a copy instead (can be switched off in Settings).

data.name: GuideAreaText
data.value: Copy area (Home ▸ Redact, also in the Edit menu) copies any part of a page as a picture – text, pictures, stamps and boxes as they are shown: draw a frame around it. The copy then follows the pointer; a click places it in its original size, on the same page, another page or in another window. Esc stops pasting but keeps the copy: Paste (next to Undo) or {0}+V places it again, as often as you like. The pasted area covers what lies underneath; drag it to move it, pull a corner to resize it, Del removes it, Undo takes back every step. Only when saving is the content under it removed from the file for good, and the area becomes part of the page as a picture (its text cannot be searched).
